tool_args.rationale: The paid pilot reports high-frequency sign oscillation, and none of the recalled stationary laws accounts for the observed sign pattern. There is no supported forecast at H = 1.1 with RMSE at or below 0.045.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Both preserve the sign of their prefactor and cannot account for the mixed-sign observations.
For positive u_now, the model permits at most one sign change as H increases; the pilot observations show two.
A finer trajectory could characterize the oscillations, but it is not needed to make the decision given the observed high-frequency sign-oscillation signature.
